$comment: Validator-shaped files that the QA gate deliberately does NOT run.
Enforced by tools/validate-gate-coverage.mjs. Every file under tools/ and
scripts/ named validate-*, audit-*, smoke-* or verify-* must be either
executed by `npm run qa:loop` or listed here with a reason. There is no
third state: a validator that is neither is dark, and a dark validator
protects nothing while looking like it does.
An entry here is a claim that a human considered this file and decided it
should not gate a push. Stale entries fail the check — if the file is
deleted, or the gate starts running it, the exemption must go.
Triaged 2026-08-20 by running all 26 dark files and recording exit codes.
Reasons below state what was observed, not what was assumed.

exempt.tools/audit-arcade-games.mjs: Report-only runtime audit of all 20 arcade games and 6 review surfaces in a real browser (console errors, coach tip, live model, scaffold after a wrong answer, screenshots). Needs a browser and ~2 minutes, so it exits 3 (SKIP) without one; the decidable half runs on every push as tools/validate-arcade-models.mjs. Run `npm run audit:arcade-games -- --out=<dir> --shots` before and after any change to the shared game scripts.
exempt.tools/validate-discourse-cra-studios.mjs: Deterministic test runner verifying RationalNumber arithmetic precision vectors, 25 authentic Grade 6 misconceptions, WIDA 2020 scoring telemetry, and cognitive strategy latency classification; run on demand or in math-fluency-lab.
exempt.tools/verify-practice-studio-fleet-brows: All 144 Practice/Challenge studios at four viewports with screenshots and a verification ledger (docs/audits/practice-studio); ~15 min, so it runs before a studio release (npm run verify:studio-fleet), not on every push. The per-push studio browser suites stay in the gate.
exempt.tools/verify-fluency-v7-browser.mjs: Chromium journeys for the 7.0 start panel and learning workspace (axe, 390/1280, Spanish, storage blocked, deep links, old saved progress); minutes of browser time, so it runs on demand and from qa:fast when math/fluency-lab/ changes, as validate:fluency-v7-browser. The engine half is tools/fluency-v7.test.mjs, which runs in npm test.
exempt.tools/verify-hub-performance-browser.mjs: Chromium suite (axe at 1440 and 390, boot-time request assertions, a Reveal early-click race, the teacher panel loaded and switched on, CWV, and five --mutate modes that must fail): about a minute, needs a served build and a browser, so it runs on demand as verify:hub-performance-browser (--base <url>) after a hub loading change. The budgets themselves are enforced by scripts/perf-curriculum.mjs in production-observability.yml, and the deferral logic by tools/reveal-document-downloads.test.mjs and tools/my-progress-atlas.test.mjs in npm test.
exempt.tools/verify-gn-layer-browser.mjs: Chromium sweep of all 39 Axiom City graphic novels at 1366x768, 768x1024 and 390x844 (cover, every page, every gate, vocabulary pop-up, Easy read round trip, gate parity against the books with the layer removed): about two minutes with --shard=k/3, needs a real browser, so it runs on demand (node tools/verify-gn-layer-browser.mjs, add --shard=k/3 to split it) after a change to graphic-novels/_shared/gn-layer.js or a book. The jsdom half (all 39 books carry exactly one block, vocabulary comes from the books' own lessons, injector idempotent and reversible, matcher equals the engine's, extraction keys unique) is tools/gn-layer.test.mjs in npm test.
exempt.tools/verify-fluency-studio-browser.mjs: Chromium suite over the Discovery Studio (axe, keyboard, reduced motion); minutes long and needs a browser, so it runs on demand as validate:fluency-studio-browser before a Studio change ships, like the other Fluency Lab browser suites.
exempt.scripts/audit-a11y.mjs: ALREADY AUTOMATED against production: production-observability.yml runs `audit:a11y -- --base https://eduwonderlab.com`. Deliberately not a push gate — it needs a browser, took 47s and could not load 2 pages in a local run, and a11y findings need judgement rather than a threshold.
exempt.scripts/audit-unit4-copyable-steps.mjs: Needs a real browser (it opens ~170 problems across the ten Unit 4 studios), so on a machine without one it exits 3 (SKIP) and verifies nothing; the static half of the same contract — each page wired to U4Studio, meaning checks generated from the problem's own numbers — runs on every push in tools/unit4-studio.test.mjs. Run `npm run audit:copyable-steps` after editing a studio page's step markup.
exempt.scripts/audit-dead-code.mjs: Reports candidates for human review and deletes nothing ('Nothing deleted — review the report and remove by hand'). Dead code is not a push-blocking defect and its heuristics have been wrong before — see the shape-3d.js near-miss.
exempt.scripts/audit-duplicate-assets.mjs: Lists byte-identical assets for a human to merge; duplication is a tidiness question, not a correctness one, and 17s of gate time buys no regression protection.
exempt.scripts/audit-misconception-coverage.mjs: Writes reports/misconception-coverage.md and judges nothing — coverage is a content-authoring backlog metric, deliberately not a pass/fail condition.
exempt.scripts/audit-score-writers.mjs: Requires a reachable, authenticated D1 binding; it correctly exits 3 (SKIP) offline. A gate that skips on most developer machines teaches people to ignore skips.
exempt.scripts/audit-small-group-ux.mjs: Report-only by design, like audit:a11y — it says so in its own header, and its findings need judgement rather than a threshold. Also slow (~2.5 min: two lessons x two widths, networkidle waits). It CRASHED until 2026-08-20 on a hidden .sg-room-code input; that is fixed, and it now skips honestly (exit 3) when no preview server is up.
exempt.scripts/audit-toc-alignment.mjs: Writes reports/toc-alignment.md for human reading. The TOC realignment it was built for is complete; it is kept as a re-audit tool, not a gate.
exempt.scripts/smoke-live.mjs: Already run by scripts/ship.sh and by the site-health and verify-deploy workflows. It hits the live origin, so it cannot judge an unpushed commit.
exempt.scripts/verify-family-resources.mjs: Needs a network and a real browser: Khan Academy answers HTTP 200 to every path, so a link is only proven by loading it. Joel runs it (npm run verify:family-resources) to refresh the record; the gate itself (validate:family-resources) reads that record offline and fails it after 180 days.
exempt.scripts/validate-lesson-quality.mjs: Prints WARN lines and exits 0 regardless, so as a gate it would be a permanent pass. It is a quality report; making it blocking is a separate decision about thresholds.
exempt.scripts/validate-lesson-visuals.mjs: ALREADY AUTOMATED, and not on the push gate by design. site-health.yml runs it weekly (Mondays 11:00 UTC) in a dedicated `lesson-visuals` job with --concurrency 4; the browser sweep over ~220 lessons x 8 phases is far too slow for a pre-push gate. Its static half (`--static-only`, 0.25s) DOES run on every push via tools/lesson-visuals-static.test.mjs. Reachability reads as 'unreached' here only because the coverage walker follows package.json, not CI workflows.
exempt.scripts/validate-production.mjs: Checks the DEPLOYED site (137.8s, passing) — wrong side of the gate: the push gate proves what is about to ship, this proves what already shipped. Belongs in verify-deploy.yml. Its classification logic IS unit-tested on every push by tools/validate-production.test.mjs, which imports CHECKS/classify/overallExit; the orchestration is what is not gated.
exempt.tools/audit-allowlist.mjs: Already run by .github/workflows/predeploy-verify.yml. Its CVE acceptances are time-boxed ('accepted until 2026-11-09'), so it is a scheduled-expiry check, not a per-push one.
exempt.tools/audit-copy-panel-provenance.mjs: Writes docs/copy-panel-provenance.md. The blocking half of this subject is validate:copy-panels, which IS in the gate; this is its human-readable companion.
exempt.tools/audit-interaction-depth.mjs: Writes reports/interaction-depth.{json,md}. Depth is a judgement about instructional quality that a threshold cannot make — the maturity pass established the numbers are already healthy.
exempt.tools/audit-interaction-quality.mjs: Writes reports/interaction-quality.{json,md} and judges nothing. Same reason as the depth audit: a reporting instrument for planning passes.
exempt.tools/audit-lesson-alignment.mjs: States its own limit: 'Reported, not judged: an unflagged lesson has not been individually read.' A tool that explicitly declines to judge cannot be a pass/fail gate.
exempt.tools/audit-small-group-quality.mjs: Writes reports/small-group-quality-audit.md for review during small-group content passes. No pass/fail semantics.
exempt.tools/fluency-guide/verify-workshops-bro: Change-scoped browser suite (~46s, boots 24 workshop pages in headless Chromium): executed automatically by scripts/qa-run.mjs COVERAGE whenever curriculum/fluency/ or tools/fluency-guide/ changes, or on demand via npm run validate:fluency-workshops-browser.
exempt.tools/scorm/validate-scorm-self-containe: DECIDED 2026-08-20: stays out of `validate`. CLAUDE.md documents the live-iframe design as intentional and this gate as holding that contract rather than policing it per push, and its runtime probe FAILS in CI without a browser, which would turn CI red on infrastructure grounds. It passes and is stable (3/3 runs). Revisit only if the self-containment contract itself changes.
exempt.tools/smoke-planning.mjs: Exits 3 (SKIP) — one planner check cannot run without a live planner backend. Honest about verifying nothing, but a gate that skips by default is decoration. Wire it once it can run offline.
exempt.tools/verify-flagship-studio.mjs: Explicit browser release check requiring a running Vite server and Playwright. Executed for the October 2026 game release: 13 boots, native controls, pause, correct-answer and retry paths passed; documented in docs/game-studio/cabinet-verification.md. Kept separate from the serverless push gate.
exempt.tools/verify-studio-lab-browser.mjs: Change-scoped browser suite (headless Chromium, ~2-4 min for every bench): drives the lab bench inside every Practice and Challenge studio the way a student does (a wrong test that must explain, the right setting, the written items, the whole adaptive mission, reload-resume, Spanish stack, 375px overflow, axe). Executed automatically by scripts/qa-run.mjs COVERAGE whenever the practice studios, assets/studio/*, the learning-lab shared modules or the bench data change, or on demand via npm run validate:studio-lab-browser.
exempt.tools/verify-studio-enhancements-browser: Change-scoped browser suite (~10s, headless Chromium): Comfort settings on 13 studio pages at 375px, a Skill Quest run, the Daily Boost memory and a streak toast. Executed automatically by scripts/qa-run.mjs COVERAGE whenever the practice studios, assets/studio-comfort.* or the Unit 4 studio pages change, or on demand via npm run validate:studio-enhancements-browser.
exempt.tools/verify-studio-linked-models-browse: Change-scoped browser suite (~5s, headless Chromium): drives linked ratio representations (table, double number line, coordinate ray) in 3-3 and invariant base-times-height parallelogram shearing in 5-1 across desktop and mobile viewports. Executed by scripts/qa-run.mjs COVERAGE or on demand via npm run validate:studio-linked-models-browser.
exempt.tools/verify-studio-pathways-browser.mjs: Change-scoped browser suite (~40s, headless Chromium): verifies all 144 direct practice routes initialize, exercises four mobile diagnostic layouts, and proves diagnostic evidence isolation and focused-route persistence. Executed by scripts/qa-run.mjs COVERAGE or on demand via npm run validate:studio-pathways-browser.
exempt.tools/verify-u4-adaptive-browser.mjs: Change-scoped browser suite (~8s, headless Chromium): verifies all ten Unit 4 custom routes, live mathematical models, mobile width compliance, 4-5 error -> new independent problem -> saved evidence, and Challenge construction checks. Executed by scripts/qa-run.mjs COVERAGE or on demand via npm run validate:u4-adaptive-browser.
exempt.tools/verify-family-design-system-browse: Family Math Studio design-system specimen driven in headless Chromium (24 theme/language/width runs, axe, focus rings, forced colors, reduced motion, behavior; ~60s), run on demand via npm run validate:family-design-system-browser. A missing browser is a SKIP (3 locally, 1 in CI), never a pass.

Wire it into validate when the kit ships.
exempt.tools/verify-family-art-browser.mjs: Opt-in browser suite (npm run validate:family-art-browser, ~8s, headless Chromium), not in the gate yet: drives design/family-system/art.html at 320, 768 and 1280px in light and dark (no horizontal scroll, axe clean, every svg hidden or titled, unique ids, no external request) and writes screenshots to docs/family-homework-v3/art/. SKIP without a browser.
exempt.tools/verify-family-a11y.mjs: Change-scoped browser suite (an evenly spread sample of 8 pages (every unit and page kind) in qa:fast, all 166 with --all before a release): axe WCAG 2.2 A/AA (serious and critical fail) plus in-page probes for unnamed controls, duplicate ids, heading outline, the inactive language out of the accessibility tree, skip link and landmarks, text and tap-target sizes, polite live regions, tap alternatives to drag and canvas, focus ring, forced colors, reduced motion, 200% zoom and 400% reflow, in English and Spanish at 390 and 1280. Seeds every defect and its clean twin first and fails on a sweep that measured nothing. Executed by scripts/qa-run.mjs COVERAGE when the homework generator, its lib modules or assets/homework/ change; exclusive of the other Chromium suites.
exempt.tools/verify-family-experience-browser.m: Change-scoped browser suite (~45s for the 8-lesson sample, ~15 min with --all, headless Chromium): drives the family homework page the way a family does at 390px and 1280px — language picker first on the first screen, Start within two screens, a type floor of 13px, 44px tap targets, no fixed control on top of another, a wrong answer is not progress, four right answers open the mystery challenge, progress survives a reload without a second fanfare, Quick means two, reset asks in the page and never in a native dialog. Executed automatically by scripts/qa-run.mjs COVERAGE whenever the homework generator, its lib modules, assets/homework/ or the Learning-supports stylesheet change, or on demand via npm run validate:family-experience-browser.
exempt.tools/verify-learning-labs-browser.mjs: Change-scoped browser suite (~35s, sweeps 77 learning labs in headless Chromium): executed automatically by scripts/qa-run.mjs COVERAGE whenever curriculum/learning-labs/, data/learning-labs.json, or tools/learning-labs/ changes, or on demand via npm run validate:learning-labs-browser.
exempt.tools/validate-engine-games-browser.mjs: Change-scoped browser suite for the physics engine games (math/games/engines/<slug>/): executed by scripts/qa-run.mjs COVERAGE whenever an engine game, its core or its tests change, or on demand via npm run validate:engine-games-browser. Plays 4 rounds of every game by keyboard only (real Tab traversal), checks screen-reader semantics, EN/ES toggle, axe, 390px reflow, FPS under 4x CPU throttle and per-frame heap allocation (CDP sampling). A missing browser is a SKIP (3 locally, 1 in CI), never a pass.

Recounts every filter from data/project-registry.json, drives URL state, all 30 detail dialogs, seeded Continue, blocked storage, script off and axe. A missing browser is a SKIP (3 locally, 1 in CI), never a pass.
exempt.tools/validate-projects-portfolio-browse: Change-scoped browser suite (~60s, /math/projects/portfolio/ at 1440/820/390 in headless Chromium, ~100 checks): executed automatically by scripts/qa-run.mjs COVERAGE whenever the portfolio page, its modules, generator or seed lib, the Studio completion modules, the Studio, or the project registry change, or on demand via npm run validate:projects-portfolio-browser. Seeds Studio completions, saves, classic Save/Resume records and legacy completions in localStorage and recounts every status, tile, artifact and resume link from the seeds and data/project-registry.json; proves a certificate only appears for a valid completion record and prints on one landscape page; drives the Studio completion button (ready work only, never partial, teacher view or exemplar); blocked storage, script off, reduced motion and axe. A missing browser is a SKIP (3 locally, 1 in CI), never a pass.
exempt.tools/verify-project-studio-browser.mjs: Change-scoped browser suite (~90s, walks 8 project studios x 3 phases in headless Chromium): executed automatically by scripts/qa-run.mjs COVERAGE whenever curriculum/projects/studio/ changes, or on demand via npm run validate:project-studio-browser.
exempt.tools/validate-all-resources-browser.mjs: Change-scoped browser suite (~20s: desktop and phone, unit browse, search counts against an independent recount, Back/refresh/direct-link state, Show more, the Tools tab, keyboard focus, 44px targets and axe WCAG A/AA/2.2 in headless Chromium): executed by scripts/qa-run.mjs COVERAGE whenever curriculum/all-resources/ or any curriculum/<tool>/index.html changes, or on demand via npm run validate:all-resources-browser. exempt.tools/validate-contrast-browser.mjs: Computed text contrast (AA 4.5 / large 3.0), non-text UI 3.0 and the warm-up correct/incorrect feedback banners across entry, lesson and every phase; counts gradient/image backgrounds as unjudgeable instead of guessing. Needs a SERVED build (it starts its own server over dist/ when no --base is given, else pass --base http://localhost:4603 from `npx vite preview --port 4603`) and a Chromium; with neither it exits 3 (SKIP) via tools/lib/skip-exit.mjs, 1 in CI, never 0. Sweeps all 84 core lessons (--lessons a,b / --viewport WxH narrow it) and FAILS an empty or shallow sweep (under 80 lessons, under 90% entered, under 3 states per run). Deliberately NOT in `validate` or the push gate: it takes tens of minutes and the first measured baseline fails on real findings, so wiring it now would block every unrelated push; decide with Joel when the fleet is clean enough to enforce. Its negative controls (tools/validate-contrast-browser.test.mjs, seeded defects on static fixtures) DO run on every `npm test`.
